review:
Noche de Almas is a Día de los Muertos cluster slot about two souls reuniting across the boundary of death, with a dark, high-contrast style. It combines cluster pays with an on-reel Coin Respin.

Its standout feature, Reel Deal, condenses 500 spins into a reveal of the three best results. You can add one of five extra features, such as a Booster that keeps a candle in play or Chance x5, and a Rebuy button repeats your last bonus purchase where permitted. BGaming rates it very high volatility with a 10,000x maximum and a 97% RTP. Free spins arrive about once every 300 spins.
pros: Excellent 97.00% RTP – among the highest published
